place_fields.summary: A waterfall near Suntikoppa in Kandanakolli, Kodagu, with a local visitor account describing a quiet, uncrowded setting.

planning_attributes.description: Haleri Waterfall is a tourist attraction on an unnamed road in the Suntikoppa/Kandanakolli area of Kodagu.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: The mapped location is on an unnamed road in Suntikoppa/Kandanakolli; a local visitor account places the falls about 2 km from a homestay in the Suntikoppa area.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Do not infer safe bathing conditions from visitor reports; waterfall conditions can change with rainfall.
planning_attributes.notes: Google Maps identifies the attraction at CQWR+89R, Suntikoppa, Karnataka 571237.

place_fields.micro_region: Surlabbi, Somwarpet taluk, Kodagu district, Karnataka
place_fields.summary: A seasonal waterfall near Surlabbi, formed by a small stream flowing through several rocky steps in a green setting.

planning_attributes.description: Surlabbi Falls, also called Medura Abbi or Medarahole Falls, is a lesser-explored waterfall between Garwale and Surlabbi in Kodagu.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: The waterfall is close to a motorable road and can be reached by private vehicle; the site is in the Surlabbi area of Somwarpet taluk.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: Entry is generally described as free, but visitors are advised not to enter the water during the monsoon.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Water flow can become strong during the monsoon; slippery terrain and changing waterfall conditions warrant caution.
planning_attributes.notes: Recent map listings place the attraction at HPFX+936, Surlabbi, Karnataka 571251.

place_fields.summary: A lesser-known seasonal waterfall in the Mukkodlu area of Coorg, surrounded by green landscape and described as relatively quiet and non-commercialized.

planning_attributes.description: Kotē Abbey Waterfalls, also listed as Kote Abbe or Kote Abbi Falls, is a seasonal waterfall near Mukkodlu in Kodagu district.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: There is no bus service from Madikeri to the falls; travel guides describe renting a jeep because the approach is a bumpy rough ride, with the falls about 25 km from Madikeri.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: Visitors are advised not to enter the water during the monsoon; local listings also report restrictions on entering or swimming at the falls.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: The rough approach and wet waterfall environment require caution; avoid entering the water during high-flow periods.
planning_attributes.notes: The mapped attraction is listed at GPCQ+VPC, Kote Abbe Falls, Karnataka 571251.
